notes.new_features: Auto-update fixed, comprehensive system collector report, network reachability fixes
improvements: FIXED: Auto-updater was completely non-functional since its introduction (wrong repo URL, config path type error, platform key mismatch, NSIS-style install on a portable exe)
FIXED: Windows executable was unreachable from the LAN (bound to 127.0.0.1 only) - now binds 0.0.0.0
FIXED: mDNS (parcinfo.local) and Windows Firewall rule now set up automatically on the packaged exe
FIXED: Uploads/documents sync thread never started on the packaged exe
FIXED: documents_interventions and baie_photos were missing the columns needed to sync at all
FIXED: OS name/RAM sync to device sheet (dropdown fields replaced with free-text + suggestions)

System info collector: removed WMI dependency (native Windows APIs), full software inventory with version/publisher/install date, BitLocker/firewall/TPM/Secure Boot, GPU, SMART disk health, uptime, domain, battery
System report is now a proper PDF (was HTML) with all collected data
